body:
New web/src/social.ts (friend-requests, friends, duels against IDUNA's /api/v1/games/deadweight/... routes) + a new Friends & Duels section in index.html/main.ts, shown once an account is bootstrapped. Works for any account (guest or email-linked). tsc strict-mode clean, JS syntax-checked, headless-Chrome screenshot of the page shell. Not live-clicked-through yet -- IDUNA's new routes aren't deployed, and this session's own signup rate cap was already spent. DEADWEIGHT commit 4490a70. Closes the WEB CLIENT half of the in-game friends/duel UI backlog item; the native SDL2 client (apps/gui/main.c) still has no friends/duel UI.

⚓ ☃
